The Role:  Riggy acts as a model and actor who stars alongside Danno in educational, fast-fact YouTube Shorts. He also runs his own Riggy The Rabbit Monkey YouTube Channel. Traditional Ragi millet recipe To prepare Ragi Kali, ragi flour is mixed with water to form a smooth batter, which is then cooked over low heat until it thickens. The key to a good Ragi Kali is to continuously stir the mixture to prevent lumps from forming. Once cooked, it is typically served hot with a side dish such as sambar, chutney, or curry. Overall, Ragi Kali is a simple yet nutritious dish that showcases the versatility and health benefits of ragi flour.#Ragi recipes #millet #milletrecipe #healthy #healthyrecipes #cooking #food #foodvideo #tiktok
